newsitem.title: ESTONIA: Estonian shares in light trade as calm returns.
newsitem.headline: Estonian shares in light trade as calm returns.

text.p: Share trade on the Estonian stock exchange fell back to very quiet levels on Wednesday and dealers said market players were sitting back after a period of relatively hectic activity.
Volume on the main list was just 1.9 million kroons and the over-the-counter free market turned over 5.1 million kroons. The Tallinn stock exchange index fell 0.25 percent to 103.99.
"Investors have calmed down after the last days on the market and prices are stable," said Savings Bank trader Charlie Viikberg.
The market had been active amid a spate of nine-month financial reports and corporate news.
On the free market list, only Tallinna Kaubamaja and the Rakvere meat plant had trade of over one million kroons.
Kaubamaja, which said yesterday it plans to open a branch next year in Helsinki, rose to 58.95 kroons from 58 kroons.
Rakever turned over 1.8 million kroons of stock and closed at 6.10 versus 6.05 kroons.
